1. **F1 — Tail capture misclassifies a valid long final event line.** `captured_log_end` reduces an event log to its last 4096 bytes, then treats that suffix as the complete final line at [mutation.rs:680](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/repository_state/mutation.rs:680). A valid unterminated final JSON event longer than the window therefore becomes an invalid JSON suffix and is rejected as an uncertified torn tail at line 1242. Event payloads can contain unbounded profile/variable collections, and no line-size constraint rules this input out. Ordinary state mutations then fail instead of appending their event. This is blocking, issue-impact. References: `@/issue/c88822a5/requirement/REQ-03`, `@/invariant/event-log`.
